snippet.title: Panther - Dooriyan ft. @Akankshachoudhary_official (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
Some distances are measured in miles. The hardest ones are measured in memories.

Dooriyan is a story of love that refuses to fade, even when life pulls two people apart. It's about unanswered prayers, unspoken words, and the hope that some hearts never truly let go of each other.

If you've ever missed someone who still lives in your thoughts, this one's for you.

Stream Dooriyan on all audio platforms.
Let us know in the comments: Who does this song remind you of? 💬

Subscribe here - https://www.youtube.com/c/buildingpanther

Lyrics

na jane kaise faasley
na jane kaise hai giley
na jaane kaise rastey
na jane kaisi manzilein hai
na jane kitne hadsey
humpe aake hai girey
na jane kiske wastey hai sahey
lekin na rakhte hai giley

tumse ye dooriyan mita dengi
humko ye dooriyaan hi marengi
bin tere jeena mushqil ho gaya hai janejaan
ye dooriyan kya jaan leke manengi

bana ke rakhna tumse fasla
lage jaise bin mitti ka paudha
mai har bazi tumpe hi haru
khatir tere kar lu mai ghatey ka sauda
mai pyaasa aur pani hai tu
raha zamana jala, 
de chune bhar ka mauka
qubool hai tere pehlu sarey 
tu jaise khuda ka hai tohfa

khuda se mai dua padhu teri
mangu ram se puja me tujhe
ye duniya tere bin hai khokhli
har jagah tbhi dhundha hai tumhe
humko chahat na badan ki tere
bas tera hai choona man mujhe 
tu sachai hai iss wajood ki
baki toh lagta hai jhutha sab mujhe

umeedein mujhko tere wapis aane ki
barbadi na hui to kya hi ashiqui
to bata fir kyu iss tarah hum chahey nahi
aur tum bhi khoob 
jo ab tak aaye nahi

tumse ye dooriyan mita dengi
humko ye dooriyaan hi marengi
bin tere jeena mushqil ho gaya hai janejaan
ye dooriyan kya jaan leke manengi


Credits

Audio Credits
Artist - Panther
Prod. by Outsky
Engineered by Sidhant Choudhury

Visual Credits
Directed/Edited/CG by Sahil Akhtar
DOP - Muheeb Sheikh

AD & Production Asst. - Vicky Pandey
Still & BTS by Satyendra Srivastav

Emraan Hashmi returns as the iconic Shivam in the much-awaited sequel to the cult classic Awarapan. Starring Disha Patani alongside Emraan Hashmi, Awarapan 2 promises an emotional journey filled with love, betrayal, redemption, action, and soulful music.

🎵 Emotional Romance
🔥 Intense Action
💔 Heartbreaking Sacrifice

snippet.title: [EN] 2026 PMMI Grand Finals Day 1
snippet.description:
🔴  2026 PUBG MOBILE MACAO INVITATIONAL 🔴

🔥One vs All !

🔈2026 PMMI will unfold in two stages across six heated competition days.
🌍 This tournament will feature 25 top-tier teams from multiple regions worldwide.

🗓 Group Stage Days
● June 29 (Mon) - 17:20 (GMT+8:00)
● June 30 (Tue) - 17:20 (GMT+8:00)
● July 1 (Wed) - 17:20 (GMT+8:00)

Finals
● July 3 (Fri) - 15:40 (GMT+8:00)
● July 4 (Sat) - 15:40 (GMT+8:00)
● July 5 (Sun) - 16:00 (GMT+8:00)

🎖️Participating teams
GOAT  #2026 PMGO S1 EECA #2
A7 #2025 PMGC #1
AURORA  #2026 PMGO S1 EECA #1
BTR #2025 PMHI #3
DK #2026 PMPS S1 #5
EA  #2026 PMGO S1 SEA #2
FURIA  #2026 PMGO S1 SAM #1
INF # 2026 PMGO S1 SAM #5
KONE  # 2026 PEL Spring #7
KRX #2026 PMPS S1 #4
KSG  # 2026 PEL Spring #5
LGD  # 2026 PEL Spring #3
NGX  #2026 PMGO S1 MENA #2
NS #2026 PMPS S1 #1  
REG # 2025 PMGO #1
RRQ  #2026 PMGO S1 SEA #3 
S2G #2026 PMGO S1 TUR #4
TIANBA  # 2026 PEL Spring #6
TT  # 2026 PEL Spring #2
ULA  #2026 PMGO S1 MENA #1
ULF # 2026 PMGO S1 TUR #1
WBG  # 2025 PMHI #1
WOL  # 2026 PMGO S1 NA  #1  
YG #2025 PMWC #1
AG # 2026 PEL Spring #1

💸 Total prize pool：$440,000 USD

🔔Format
●  24 teams divided into three groups. Each group plays six matches against each other, and the 15 teams with the highest total points advance to the finals.
●  PEL Spring Split champion AG qualifies directly for the final stage. 16 teams will compete in a total of 18  matches over three days to contend for the final championship.

🔔Smash rule
● Reach match point and secure a WWCD in the next matches to become the champion.
● Match point: rank#1 in points + 10 points at the end of the match 12/18 (Day2)
● If no wins by smash after 18 matches, the team ranked #1 by overall points wins!"

मुखड़ा
अपना मेहर से तू त, कुछ त छुपावातारा

ख़ाली हमके सतावातारा, नया छोकरी पटावातारा

अंतरा
तहरो जवानी चढ़ल हमरो जवानी 
तब काहे बहरा काटेला जाके चानी 
( हम कहाँ फ़ानी )
रोज़ नया नया करेला तलाश राजाजी 
हम सूत जाईब खाके सल्फ़ाश राजाजी 

घरवा में छोड़ी कनिया, नचनिया नचावातारा 
रुपया उड़ावातारा, नया छोकरी पटावातारा
ख़ाली हमके सतावातारा, नया छोकरी पटावातारा

अंतरा
प्रिंस प्रियांशु के लागल बा दुआ
तबे मरद तू भेटईला लफूआ 
( साफ़ लफुआ हो गईला … ए हो )
आजे पता हमरा चलल बा डीपीया से 
तोहर चलाता चक्कर शिलीपिया से 

ले ले तू बाड़ऽ टेंडर, ब्लेंडर पियावातारा

snippet.title: Bol Bol Rani - Official Movie Trailer | Sai Tamhankar, Subodh Bhave, Chinmay Mandlekar| 17 JULY 2026
snippet.description:
A small town. Highly atmospheric. Utterly flavourful, where everyone knows everyone. Range of personalities. Range of motives. Range of emotions. The idea of truth. Versions of truth. And three stories leading towards the ultimate truth.

There is an incident in town, and suddenly the fabric of the town changes!

A young journalist sets out on an adventurous, partly tragic, partly humorous and deeply mysterious journey to unearth this crime.

Batana chhod diya...
ab dard bhi apna lagta hai.

Pehle har baat
tumse keh diya karte the...

haal batana chhod diya.

insaan badal nahi jaata...

khamosh ho gaya.

shikayat karte hain...

bas har dard ko
muskurakar sehna seekh liya hai.

dard bhi hai,
khamoshi bhi hai,

jo dheere se kehta hai —

kabhi kisi ko
apni rooh se zyada chaha ho

snippet.title: Teri Yaadon Ki Chadar Odhe Official Video Dil Ne Tera Naam Liya #bollywood #hindisong #2026
snippet.description:
Teri Yaadon Ki Chadar Odhe (Official Video ) (Dil Ne Tera Naam Liya) || Romantic Bollywood Hits Song 2026
Dil Ne Tera Naam Liya 2.0 💞 90s Bollywood Romantic Vibe | Soulful New Version

Song - Teri Yaadon Ki Chadar Odhe


तेरे बिना सूना है जहाँ, तेरे बिना तन्हा है दिल,
तेरे बिना हर धड़कन में, बस गूँजता है तेरा सिलसिला।
तेरी यादों की चादर ओढ़े, हर रात गुज़र जाती है,
तेरी तस्वीर आँखों में, फिर भी आँखें भीग जाती हैं।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

तेरे होंठों की मुस्कान में, मैंने खुदा का नूर देखा,
तेरे आँचल की छाँव में, सारा सुकून देखा।
तेरी आवाज़ में वो मिठास है, जो साजों को जगा देती है,
तेरी खामोशी भी अब तो, मेरी रूह को सजा देती है।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

कभी तेरी बातें याद आईं, तो दिल मुस्कुरा उठा,
कभी तेरी दूरी ने छू लिया, तो दिल बिखर उठा।
तेरे बिना जो जीना पड़ा, वो जीना ना रहा,
तेरे बिना हर लम्हा मेरा, अधूरा-सा रहा।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

तेरे जाने के बाद भी, तेरा एहसास रहता है,
हर शाम तेरी यादों का, साया पास रहता है।
तेरे ख़त के अक्षर अब भी, महकते हैं जैसे फूल,
तेरे नाम से ही चलती हैं, मेरी हर मंज़िल की धूल।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

तेरी आँखों में जो गहराई है, उसमें मेरा जहाँ है,
तेरे इश्क़ की पनाहों में, मेरी पहचान है।
तेरी राहों में बिछ जाऊँ, अगर तू मुस्कुराए,
तेरी ख़ुशी में अपनी हर सांस, मैं कुर्बान कर जाऊँ।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

कभी खामोशी में तेरा नाम लूँ, तो आँसू चल पड़ते हैं,
कभी तेरे ख़्वाबों में खो जाऊँ, तो लम्हे थम पड़ते हैं।
तेरे जाने के बाद भी, दिल तुझसे बातें करता है,
हर तन्हा रात में अब भी, तेरा ही ज़िक्र करता है।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

अब बस इतना कह दूँ तुझसे, लौट आ किसी बहाने,
तेरे बिना ये दिल मेरा, टूटे पत्ते जैसा दीवाने।
तेरे प्यार में ही तो मेरी, दुनिया पूरी होती है,
तेरे आने से ही मेरी, ज़िंदगी रोशन होती है।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

Some people smile with you, celebrate with you, and call themselves your friends—until the moment they find a chance to betray you. **GADDAR** captures those emotions through powerful lyrics, raw vocals, and hard-hitting production.

This track is dedicated to everyone who has been backstabbed, lied to, or left behind by people they once trusted. Sometimes the biggest lesson in life is realizing that not everyone standing beside you is truly with you.

If this song connects with your journey, don't forget to **Like, Comment, Share, and Subscribe**.

snippet.title: Sintaa - Jadugarni ( Official Music Video )
snippet.description:
Presenting the latest Haryanvi track “Jadugarni” by Sintaa — a powerful vibe straight from the heart of Haryana. If you love desi swag, energetic beats, and authentic Haryanvi culture, this track is for you!

Song Credits:
Title: Jadugarni
Singer/Lyrics/Composer : Sintaa
Additional Lyrics : Filmy
Female Lead : Twinkle Mahajann
Music : Riyaazi
Mix Master: D Chandu
Video Director : MP Sega
Dop : John 
AD : Yogi Patter
Video: Sega Production
Edit & DI : Yatin Arora
Casting : Rekha Thakur
Line Producer : Aman Gill & Sandeep
Spot Team : Suraj
Costume Designer: Rajat Manchanda
Choreographer : Rekha 
Astt. Choreographer : Ginni Bhola
Dancers : Team Sandy

Reels Promotions: Reel Nation
Spotify Promotion: Nyx Media
Publicity Designs: Poster Boy

Lyrics : 
Tera Rup s badal pani ka jo barse haye bin saman ke 
Issa jadu kargi dil p re na chalte jhaade baman ke 

tera rup khara heera laage na chaale kisse ke tore ki na chala kisse ke tore ki 
ek nazar hass k dekhi re tnne umar bda di chore ki 

Tu gaal mein likdi phar k to tnne daam bhada diye daman ke
Tera Rup s badal pani ka jo barse haye bin saman ke 
Issa jadu kargi dil p re na chalte jhaade baman ke  

mote mote nain tere ko khel kraake maanegi
bhole bhale chhore ki tu jail kraake maanegi
re jail krake manegi
bhabhi kuwa dyun tnne mere chhote bhai p 
funk dyange dhan shak kre na kamai p
mithi kar tone chhori ghra kr phone chhori 
ke legi teri bebe ribn katai p 

tirchi tirchi dekhe jb tu nain jhuka de nagan ke
Tera Rup s badal pani ka jo barse haye bin saman ke 
Issa jadu kargi dil p re na chalte jhaade baman ke 


sbki nazar dte tere p likde jb tu gala m 
fansi kha jyange balak tere kale kale baala m
tu kai kai bandh ri dore chhori nazar tokk n datan ke
Tera Rup s badal pani ka jo barse haye bin saman ke 
Issa jadu kargi dil p re na chalte jhaade baman ke

Watch & Enjoy Gundu Sudhi Song with Telugu Lyrics from the Blockbuster Telugu Movie Chatrapathi, featuring Prabhas, Shriya Saran, Music Composed by MM Keeravani and Directed by SS Rajamouli on Maa Paata Mee  Nota.  

#GunduSudhi #Chatrapathi #Prabhas #ShriyaSaran #MMKeeravani #Sunitha #SSRajamouli 

🎧 Song Credits🎙 

Song Name: Gundu Sudhi
Singers: M. M. Keeravani, Sunitha
Lyrics: Chandrabose
Music Director: M. M. Keeravani

Movie Details:-

Movie Name: Chatrapathi
Banner: Sri Venkateswara Cine Chitra
Producer: B. V. S. N. Prasad
Director: S. S. Rajamouli
Star Cast: Prabhas, Shriya Saran
Music: M. M. Keeravani 

#TeluguSongs #LoveSongs #RomanticMelodies #EvergreenHits #TeluguPopularSongs #TeluguMelodySongs #TeluguLyricalSongs #MaaPaataMeeNota

Gundu Sudhi Song Telugu Lyrics:-

గుండుసూది.. గుండుసూది… గుచ్చుకుంది గుండుసూదీ
గుంజిందయ్యో  గుండె నాది గుట్టు లాగిందయ్యో పండులూదీ
గుండుసూది.. గుండుసూది… గుచ్చుకుంటే తప్పు నాది
తగ్గించన నెప్పి నీది  హాయ్ తెపించన ఊది ఊది…
 
తగిన వేళల తొలిసారి పెదవి వేళల మలిసారి
పడక వేళల ప్రతిసారి పగటి వేళల ఒకసారి
ఈ కోపతాపలన్ని తీరేలాగా నన్నే ఊపాలి బ్రహ్మచారి
నీ గోరువంకలోన చేరే వేళ నేనే అయిపోనా భామాచారి
అమ్మమొ అబ్బబ్బబో అయ్యయ్యయ్యో అన్నా వినక
అచచో చిచో పిచో సిగులకే సెలవిచో వచ్చేయ్ వెనక
చూపలయ్యో ఊపు నీది నాకు చెప్పాలయ్యో తీపి సోది
 
నీకు బోలెడు అది ఉంది నాకు బూటెడు ఇది ఉంది
ఎత్తిపోతల పదునుంది ఉక్కపోతల పని ఉంది
మత్తుల్లో  గమత్తుల్లో  ముంచెత్తాలి నేడే తేనెల్లో ఈది ఈది
చాటుల్లో మాటుల్లోన ఆడే ఆటల్లోనా మారాలి తేదీ తేదీ
ఇంకింకా ఇంకా ఇంకా కావలింకా అహ చురక
స్త్రీ లంక చూడలింకా నాతోనే కూడింకా చిపో అనక
నచ్చావయ్యో ఉగ్రవాది నిన్ను చేసేయనా జన్మ ఖైదీ

दिखे कोना गमले कीकर

सुरक्षा सेठ र मांगे स

कोना बस्की टक्कर करनी  
ढूगे टंगरी खपरबहरनी 
र या भेट र मांगे स 

म्हारा कोय क्राइम प्रसासन न बारीक ना लागे  
ईसा कोई कोर्ट नहीं स जड़े महरी थारिक ना लगे  
पान साथ डब्बे खाली कोना होले गोली

कन्हौरीआला बाँधदे मोटर  
पानी कोना मांगे सुनले  
खून यो घेट र मांगे स  

हड्डी गंगा जी मैं तरनी  
कोना बस्की टक्कर करनी  
ढूगे टंगरी खपरबहरनी 
र या भेट र मांगे स

snippet.title: O Belake - Music Video | MOTHER PROMISE | Daali Dhananjaya | Poorna Mysore | July 10
snippet.description:
#OBelake #MotherPromise
 
O Belake is a heartfelt prayer song from the film Mother Promise. Centered on the values of humanity, unity, friendship, and compassion, the song is a reminder that love and kindness have the power to bring people together, even in the toughest of times. 
We extend our heartfelt gratitude to Sri Sri Siddalinga Mahaswamigalu, and the administration, staff, and students of Sri Siddaganga Mutt for their support and hospitality during the filming. We are honored that the entire Mother Promise cast joined them in prayer, making the experience truly memorable.
 
Mother Promise releases worldwide on July 10.

ಓ ಬೆಳಕೆ ಬಾ ಮನಕೆ ತುಂಬಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವೆ

ಜೀವಕೆ ಜೀವ ತುಂಬುವ
ಪ್ರೇಮದ ಸಸಿಯನಾಗಿಸು

localized.description:
#OBelake #MotherPromise
 
O Belake is a heartfelt prayer song from the film Mother Promise. Centered on the values of humanity, unity, friendship, and compassion, the song is a reminder that love and kindness have the power to bring people together, even in the toughest of times. 
We extend our heartfelt gratitude to Sri Sri Siddalinga Mahaswamigalu, and the administration, staff, and students of Sri Siddaganga Mutt for their support and hospitality during the filming. We are honored that the entire Mother Promise cast joined them in prayer, making the experience truly memorable.
 
Mother Promise releases worldwide on July 10.

"Oh Belake"
Lyrics: Daali Dhananjaya
Singer: Danvi Ashwin, Medha Bharadwaj, Bhanushree Datta Kumar, Svojas Gautam
Music Director: Navaneeth Sham 
Music Production: Navaneeth Sham

Bass: Bruthuva Bhushan Caleb

Lyrics:

ಓ ಬೆಳಕೆ ಬಾ ಮನಕೆ ತುಂಬಿಕೆೊಳ್ಳುವೆ
ದ್ವೇಷವಳಿಯಲಿ ಸ್ನೇಹವರಳಲಿ 

ನಾನೆನ್ನುವೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ನನ್ನದೆಂಬುವೆ
ನೀನಿಲ್ಲದ ನಾನು ಡಂಬನಲ್ಲವೇ
ದಂಡಿಸು ದಮನಿಸು ನಾನೆಂಬ ಭಾವವ
ಕರುಣಿಸು ಅರಳಿಸು ನಾವೆಂಬ ಬಾಳ್ವೆಯ

ಓ ಬೆಳಕೆ ಬಾ ಮನಕೆ ತುಂಬಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವೆ
ದ್ವೇಷವಳಿಯಲಿ ಸ್ನೇಹವರಳಲಿ

ಚಂದದ ಚಿಟ್ಟೆಯ ನನ್ನನಾಗಿಸು
ಬಗೇ ಬಗೇ ಹೂವ ತೋರಿಸು
ಮುಗಿಲಿನ ಅಂಚಿನ ಹಕ್ಕಿಯಾಗಿಸು
ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ನನ್ನ ಹಾರಿಸು

ನಿಂತಲೇ ನಿಂತು ಕೊಳೆಯದ
ಹರಿಯುವ ನದಿಯನಾಗಿಸು
ಜೀವಕೆ ಜೀವ ತುಂಬುವ
ಪ್ರೇಮದ ಸಸಿಯನಾಗಿಸು

ಹೃದಯವ ಬೆಸೆಯುವ ಕೊಂಡಿಯಾಗಿಸು
ನಿನ್ನದೇ ಸೆರೆಯಲಿ ಬಂಧಿಯಾಗಿಸು

ಓ ಬೆಳಕೆ ಬಾ ಮನಕೆ ತುಂಬಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವೆ
ದ್ವೇಷವಳಿಯಲಿ ಸ್ನೇಹವರಳಲಿ

ಯದಾ ಯದಾ ಹಿ ಧರ್ಮಸ್ಯ ಗ್ಲಾನಿರ್ಭವತಿ ಭಾರತ ।
ಅಭ್ಯುತ್ಥಾನಮಧರ್ಮಸ್ಯ ತದಾತ್ಮಾನಂ ಸೃಜಾಮ್ಯಹಂ ॥

ಪರಿತ್ರಾಣಾಯ ಸಾಧೂನಾಂ ವಿನಾಶಾಯ ಚ ದುಷ್ಕೃ ತಾಂ ।
ಧರ್ಮಸಂಸ್ಥಾಪನಾರ್ಥಾಯ ಸಂಭವಾಮಿ ಯುಗೇ ಯುಗೇ ॥

snippet.description:
ବଡ଼ଦେଉଳ ଆଜି ଖାଁ ଖାଁ ଲାଗୁଛି। ରତ୍ନବେଦୀ ଶୂନ୍ୟ ପଡ଼ିଛି ଆଉ ମୋ କାଳିଆ ସାଆନ୍ତ ଅଣସର ଘରେ ରୁଦ୍ଧଦ୍ୱାର ଭିତରେ କଷ୍ଟ ପାଉଛି। କାଳିଆର ସେହି କଳା ଶ୍ରୀମୁଖ ନଦେଖିଲେ ଭକ୍ତର ଆଖିରୁ ଲୁହ ଶୁଖେନି, ଛାତି ଫାଟିଯାଏ। କିନ୍ତୁ କାନ୍ଦୁଥିବା ଭକ୍ତକୁ ସେ ଦୟାମୟ କେବେ ଏକୁଟିଆ ଛାଡ଼ିପାରିବ କି? କଦାପି ନୁହେଁ! ଅଣସରର ଏହି ୧୫ ଦିନ ନିଜ ଭକ୍ତମାନଙ୍କର ମନର ବେଦନାକୁ ଦୂର କରିବା ପାଇଁ, ନିଜ ନୟନର ଶୋଷ ମେଣ୍ଟାଇବା ପାଇଁ ସ୍ୱୟଂ ମହାପ୍ରଭୁ ବ୍ରହ୍ମଗିରିରେ ଶ୍ରୀ ଅଲାରନାଥ ରୂପରେ ଦର୍ଶନ ଦିଅନ୍ତି। ଏହି ପବିତ୍ର ତଥା ଅଲୌକିକ ଲୀଳା ପଛରେ ଲୁଚି ରହିଥିବା ରହସ୍ୟ ଏବଂ ଭକ୍ତିର ଗାଥାକୁ ନେଇ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହୋଇଛି ଏହି ହୃଦୟସ୍ପର୍ଶୀ ଉପସ୍ଥାପନା— "ଅଲାରନାଥ କାହାଣୀ"। ସୁନାମଧନ୍ୟା କଣ୍ଠଶିଳ୍ପୀ ନମିତା ଅଗ୍ରୱାଲଙ୍କ ସ୍ନେହବୋଳା ଓ ଦରଦୀ କଣ୍ଠରେ ଏହି କଥାମୃତ ଶୁଣିଲେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ରୋମ ଟାଙ୍କୁରି ଉଠିବ।
